title: Chapter close — The Descartes Universe
html: This concludes the Descartes-universe chapter, fixing Bring's surface (\chi = -6) as the spacetime base. The substrate parameter q_0, the gauge coupling \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}}, and the five-fold symmetric basis are now established. The subsequent particle-interactions chapter applies this basis and machinery to compute mass spectra and interaction dynamics under the Gröbner–Shirshov formalisms.
